title.narrative: Strengthened framework conditions and institutional capacity of Smart Laboratory on Clean Rivers in Varanasi and partner authorities to promote holistic and sustainable rejuvenation of small rivers.

Policy, regulatory or procedural obstacles for enhancing collaboration between Government authorities, knowledge institutions, technology providers and citizens for knowledge sharing and co-creation to achieve clean river water have been addressed.

target.value: A concept note on how to establish the SLCR is agreed between Denmark and India.

actual.value: A concept note is agreed upon

target.value: The River Varuna has been established as a living lab for small rivers including the Multi-stakeholder working group as the platform to bring the different Central and State Government agencies, Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), District Administrations and state and central missions that are relevant for the Varuna River.

title.narrative: Improved frameworks for collaboration on the River Varuna as a living lab for small rivers among relevant authorities and stakeholders.

The River Varuna has been established as a living lab for small rivers including the Multi-stakeholder working group as the platform to bring the different Central and State Government agencies, Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), District Administrations and state and central missions that are relevant for the Varuna River.

target.value: - The constitution and the terms of reference for the Multi-stakeholder Working group is formulated. - Activities have been defined and few project proposals have been formulated to establish Varuna River as a Living Lab for achieving clean water in small rivers.

actual.value: Both the constitution and ToR's as well as the activities have been formulated and agreed upon.

target.value: Meetings and events for the Multi stakeholder working group to bring the different Central and State Government agencies, Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), District Administrations and state and central missions that are relevant for the Varuna River becomes a routine. - Minimum three economically, environmentally and socially sustainable projects through living lab approach by building on well proven Danish and global (including local) expertise and solutions have been showcased on River Varuna.

title.narrative: Secretariat at IIT(BHU) as the main operating body of the SLCR to handle the day-to-day activities of SLCR.

Institutional Framework Agreement between IIT(BHU) and NMCG with an initial funding from Government of India for a 10-year period has been finalised. - A business model showing how the Secretariat will be self-sustainable is prepared. The business model also includes funding for the projects. - A working methodology on bringing the Global (including Indian) sustainable solutions in SLCR is formalised. - Minimum 2 capacity-building courses with focus on global sustainable solutions and international exposure with active involvement of undergraduate, Postgraduate students, Ph.D., students are designed and minimum one course for relevant stakeholders is conducted. - Minimum one activity is conducted in collaboration with other NMCG initiatives such as River Cities alliance, Global River Cities alliance to scale up the results to other small rivers of India and Global members.

target.value: - Necessary human resources are hired and physical infrastructure is established at IIT(BHU). - Minimum three economically, environmentally, and socially sustainable projects through Living Lab approach by building on well-proven Danish and global (including local) expertise and solutions for Varuna River have been approved and work is commenced on implementing the projects. - Minimum two Capacity-building courses with focus on global sustainable solutions and international exposure with active involvement of Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Ph.D. students have been identified.

actual.value: - The process is started. - 3 projects were approved for funding at the Joint Steering Committee on 20th August 2024 and work is commenced on implementation of these 3 projects. - Will start as planned

title.narrative: Smart Monitoring and Data Collection using emerging and innovative technologies for achieving clean water to defined water quality standards have been implemented in selected stretches of Varuna River.

- Smart Monitoring system is installed for the Varuna river. - Data collection methodology and protocols of the tested technologies are prepared and approved by the Multi Stakeholder Group. - Minimum two technologies with a sound business model and net zero or negative impact on carbon emissions and net zero or positive impact on water to achieve clean water in the Varuna River are successfully demonstrated and upscaled through the SLCR mechanism.

target.value: Few emerging technologies for smart monitoring and data collection and innovative technologies for achieving clean water are shortlisted.

actual.value: Shortlisted technologies Water Collection Boat Water collection through drone Echosounder based drone PIV based drone IoT based Floating wetlands Water level stick Drone based Image water quality, object identification Smart efficient power setup for IoT / sensor devices

target.value: - The shortlisted emerging technologies for smart monitoring and data collection and innovative technologies for achieving clean water will be finalised by the Multi Stakeholder Group and approved by institutional setup of SLCR. - The project team including the subcontractors are established. - Workshops, field visits, exposure visits to prepare will be conducted. - The first prototype of the Smart Monitoring System is developed. - The first draft for data collection methodology and protocols for the tested technologies are prepared. - Work is commenced for designing and implementation of innovative technologies for achieving clean water.

- Smart Monitoring System is installed for the Varuna river. - Data collection methodology and protocols of the tested technologies are prepared and approved by the Multi stakeholder group. - The implemented technologies are monitored and evaluated for their carbon neutral water positive and economic and social sustainability.

- Establishment of long-term observatory for continuous monitoring of the Varuna river. - Implementation plan for upscaling the successful demonstrated technologies at relevant places along the Varuna River as identified in the Holistic plan and river manual.

title.narrative: Carbon Neutral and Water Principles are incorporated and demonstrated.

target.value: - Methodology to test carbon and water footprint for interventions to be tested under the SLCR concept is established and approved on the selected village. - Model villages are selected as demonstration villages by the Multi Stakeholder Working Group based on the draft holistic plan to demonstrate carbon neutral and water positive solutions. - Identifying interventions to achieve carbon negative water positive villages based on the draft holistic plan.

- Dashboard with a template to prepare carbon and water budget and showcasing the results from various interventions to achieve carbon neutral and water positive villages is developed.

title.narrative: Strengthened framework conditions and institutional capacity of Smart Laboratory on Clean Rivers and partner authorities to promote holistic and sustainable rejuvenation of small rivers that are economically, environmentally and socially sustainable in the local context through living lab approach by building on well-proven Danish and global (including local) expertise and solutions. Contributing to SDG 6.

The secretariat for Smart Laboratory on Clean Rivers in Varanasi is established and proved as a successful platform between Government authorities, knowledge institutions, technology providers and citizens for knowledge sharing and co-creation to achieve clean river water. The River Varuna is established as a living lab for showcasing economically, environmentally and socially sustainable solutions in the local context through living lab approach by building on well-proven Danish and global (including local) expertise and solutions.
